title: Normalized affine degree comparison homomorphism
statement: For affine étale objects U and W of X, g : W → U, quasi-coherent F on X and degree n, there exists an additive-group morphism from the lifted Amitsur degree term to the lifted singleton tensor-section Čech degree term, with the original pure-tensor normalization but without an invertibility assertion.

proof.text: The product projections induce ring maps on global functions compatible with the base ring, by their Over commutative triangles. Lift these maps with PiTensorProduct.liftCommAlgHom; its pure tensor equation is the product of the images.

Use the additive section restriction and its semilinearity from lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial. TensorProduct.lift applied to the semilinear bilinear map (m,b) ↦ t(b) • restriction(m) gives an additive map from the coefficient tensor product, with its pure tensor equation.

Lift the additive map by AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor and use Pi.lift to map into the outer product. Pi.lift_π and the two tensor pure-tensor equations give exactly the normalization predicate. Affineness and quasi-coherence are not needed for constructing this map; quasi-coherence remains in the unchanged signature because the codomain is defined as a sheaf Čech complex.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_singletonTensorDegreeComparison_hom
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (hU : IsAffine U.left) (hW : IsAffine W.left)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ f : (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X n ⟶
      (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n,
      IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparisonHom X F U W g n f
